d: Jet black hair is shoulder-length with choppy bangs and a messy texture, framing a youthful face with sharp, narrow violet eyes. The build is slender and fit, clad in a sleek, form-fitting black bodysuit with a high collar, paired with a long black open-front coat lined in deep purple and a utility belt with pouches. Mechanical enhancements include a heavy black armored right arm and legs encased in dark metallic plating with violet accents, topped with a black headset featuring glowing magenta antennae.
